description: Use when the user asks what offers they have resting on the XP marketplace, what they are waiting on, or before they make an offer so you do not stack a duplicate. A standing offer buys at the user's price whenever a matching fan listing appears, without them watching for it. Live offers only -- filled ones have become tickets (`get_my_tickets`) and rescinded ones are history; both stay reachable by id through `get_standing_bid`. Requires auth.
name: list_my_standing_bids
title: My Standing Offers
